text:
jordan: Heads-up — Sales asks for an allowlist + temporary burst for ACME corp (org: acme-inc). Demo in ~2.5h, they need ~1k rps for 2 hours, current quota 100 rps. Can we approve a short-lived override and pin routing to dedicated-usw2? Details: key prefix acme-prod-1.
meera: What's the exact trigger? Is this a scripted demo load or real users? Need runbook and fallback plan before we approve.
sam: Also need to run an automated abuse check. If we lift per-key, can we scope by org and limit to specific route? We should avoid global allowlist entries.
jordan: It's a scripted load from Sales demo harness (IP ranges fixed). I've attached the harness command and a short logs snippet: ```python
# curl loop
for i in range(1000):
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer acme-prod-1" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
``` 
jordan: We also want the request routed to dedicated-usw2:dense-gpu and fallback to hosted-small if capacity exhausted (failover). We prefer pinned routing during the window to avoid cross-region cold starts.
lee: Playbook suggestion: (1) Create a temporary lease in the quota-service with TTL 2h, scope=org:acme-inc, routes=[/v1/generate], max_rps=1000; (2) create console flag for the key; (3) add telemetry tag demo:acme and sampling at 100% for the window; (4) add automatic revoke job. I can run steps 1+4.
sam: For enforcement, use a soft-limit policy where per-key limiter is bumped but per-org cumulative still applies. If per-org would exceed safe capacity, route to hosted fallback. Also add rate-limit metrics and an alert if 95thP > 800 rps for >30s.
meera: We need a canary: whitelist only the demo harness IPs for first 10m then open up to full 1k. Also require a product sign-off in ticket before we flip. 
jordan: OK cc @meera @sam — I'll file a ticket and paste the ID.
support-bot: Created ticket #SUP-4872: "ACME demo temporary quota bump" assigned to eng-platform.
jordan: Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-4872 — added justification, load plan, harness IPs, and requested time window 2026-03-18T15:30Z -> 2026-03-18T17:30Z.
lee: I'll apply the quota lease and tag the key. Will also add a one-line rollback: `quota-service revoke --id lease-4872` and set auto-revoke at 17:30Z.
meera: Once lease is applied, I'll approve in the ticket. Add a note in console Rollouts UI: "temporary quota override — sales demo — auto-revokes".
sam: Security note: ensure audit logs capture the admin who applied lease and include TTL. Also add a short fuzzy-check for token replay; if we see >5 distinct IPs using that key within 5m, auto-revoke.
jordan: thanks all — please confirm when done. I'll coordinate with Sales during the window.
lee: Done: lease created id=lease-4872, scope=org:acme-inc, max_rps=1000, ttl=2h. Tagged demo:acme, telemetry sampling enabled.
meera: Approved in ticket and added canary IP rule. :thumbsup:
sam: Added alert rule and abuse-revocation hook. :shield:
jordan: Great — closing the loop. I'll monitor metrics and post a short post-mortem in case anything odd shows up.
lee: will follow up on audit logs after revoke.
support-bot: Reminder scheduled: auto-revoke lease-4872 at 2026-03-18T17:30Z.
